before_times: what you want: a new in-ground pool, a renovation, or a hot tub install
the town or ZIP, and whether you own the home (only an owner can contract a build)
roughly the yard: size, slope, and whether a machine can get in (gate width, fences, trees)
for a hot tub: photos of the spot, the panel and the path from the street
after_time: who owns the home, so every owner can be at the site visit and sign
any homeowners' association, and its approval process
known buried lines, a septic system, a well, or past flooding in the yard
children or pets at home during the build
secure_page_only: the street address, the gate code and where machines can enter
every owner of the home, each with their own link to sign
how the build is paid: the stage bills, the business's own way, or a lender (the lender's details stay in the business's own tools)
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult; the contract is signed only by the home's owners (all of them where the state's rules or the business ask); a renter needs the owner to contract it

stop.words: a child or anyone in the water and not breathing, a drowning, an electric shock near water
stop.says: Call 911 now. Get them out of the water only if it's safe, and start CPR if you know how.

stop.words: a gas smell, a downed or sparking power line in the yard
stop.says: Stay away and call 911 and the utility.

go_on.words: small children or pets at home during the build
go_on.says: the open dig and the empty shell are fenced with a temporary safety fence that stays closed; the owners keep children and pets away from the work area every day; nobody swims until the final inspection passes and the permanent barrier (fence, gates, alarms or cover the rules require) is in

go_on.words: a leaning wall, a cracked deck or an old pool that drains badly
go_on.says: the booking goes on; the site visit notes it

go_on.words: buried lines, a septic tank or a well near the dig
go_on.says: the booking goes on; the utility locate and the site plan must clear them before digging

safety_and_stop_words.business_line: Questions about soil, engineering or what a safety barrier must be go to the business's own line

prep: Clear the path for machines: move cars, furniture and plants you want to keep
Keep pets inside and children away from the work area every day
Put any gate or lockbox code on the secure page
Before plaster: water and power must be on

staff.licenses_or_certificates: the company's license holder; electricians and plumbers each licensed where the rules require it; subcontractors' licenses checked before they're named on a job
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs every proposal, change order over $1,000 and any stage bill that differs from the contract
staff.stand_in: another designer may take a site visit: the owners are told first and can pick another time instead; a build keeps its project lead unless the owner moves it; stage crews are the business's choice
staff.roles: Designers and project leads: site visits and proposals. A build lead (Leif, Joss) runs each build. Planners (Pilar, Mina) at the design center. Crews and licensed subcontractors by stage.

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult; the contract is signed only by the home's owners (all of them where the state's rules or the business ask); a renter needs the owner to contract it
children_and_age.minors_texts: never booked by a minor; a child at home is never the one who lets a crew in; a child at the pool school class comes with the parent who booked

visit.check_in: site visit and walk-throughs: the check-in code from an owner at the door; build days: nobody needs to be home, so the project lead texts a start photo and DONE with photos at the end of each stage day. Design center: the code at the desk.
visit.done: after plaster: start-up (filling and balancing the water over about 10 days), a start-up walk-through with the owners, the final inspection, then DONE
visit.changes_at_visit: a written change order, priced and signed by the owners, before any changed work: rock or water found when digging, a bigger deck, new features

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: a contractor's license for pool and spa construction where the state's rules require one (a pool or spa specialty license, or a general building license); registration only where the state licenses none; electrical and plumbing hookups by people licensed for them where the rules require it; a local building permit for every in-ground pool, and for hot tub wiring
license.who: the company holds the contractor license through its license holder; electricians and plumbers hold their own; subcontractors (excavation, gunite, tile, plaster) hold their own where the rules license their trade
license.ask: the company's contractor license number and its license holder; workers' compensation and liability insurance; any bond the state's rules require
license.insurance: liability and workers' compensation; a bond where the state's rules require it for home improvement work
license.background: Background checks only where the state's form asks

never_in_a_text: gate and lockbox codes, the lender's details and any account numbers never go in a text: only the secure page
Contract, change order and permit papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)
